title: Producing Nasal Vowels Without Nasalization? Perceptual Judgments and Acoustic Measurements of Nasal/Oral Vowels Produced by Children With Cochlear Implants and Typically Hearing Peers
why_promising: Primary sentence-repetition experiment with 38 children and 2,074 vowel productions; every vowel was manually segmented and annotated in Praat, formant outliers were manually checked/corrected, and detailed acoustic nasality measures were extracted.
open_question: Locate an openly downloadable token-level acoustic/annotation deposit or supplemental file containing the 2,074 productions/measurements. The article is open, but the current crawl did not verify a public reusable data deposit.

title: RescueSpeech: A German Corpus for Speech Recognition in Search and Rescue Domain
why_promising: Primary German speech from simulated search-and-rescue exercises; Zenodo provides 2,412 clean ASR utterances (1h36m, 26 speakers) and describes the recordings as manually annotated, with the 4-GB archive openly downloadable.
open_question: Determine exactly what 'manually annotated' means at the temporal/phonetic level inside the archive. The public README establishes primary collection and manual annotation but does not show phone/word boundary provenance; do not admit until annotation granularity is verified.

title: Karl Eberhards Corpus of spontaneously spoken southern German in dialogues
why_promising: Primary spontaneous-dialogue corpus with 40 dialogues and articulography for 20 speakers; corpus documentation reports manually corrected word boundaries with Praat annotations.
open_question: Verify public download/license and whether manually corrected word boundaries can be cleanly isolated from automatically aligned segment boundaries. Admit only the manually corrected word-level/prosodic layer unless phone boundaries were also exhaustively corrected.
